strategies.name: HYG_LQD_CREDIT_SPREAD_MOMENTUM
strategies.thesis: Credit spread widening predicts HYG underperformance vs LQD; use HYG-LQD yield spread z-score as regime filter to avoid drawdowns.
strategies.signal_construction: Monthly: if HYG-LQD spread z-score (12m rolling) < 0.5 → go HYG; else → go LQD. Rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Replaces raw 6m momentum with credit-cycle regime filter; avoids HYG during spread widening (2008, 2020).
strategies.fail_mode: Spread data stale or HYG/LQD tracking error vs index

strategies.name: DURATION_ROTATION_TLT_IEF
strategies.thesis: Rotate between long-duration (TLT) and intermediate-duration (IEF) based on 10y-2y Treasury spread slope to capture duration premium.
strategies.signal_construction: Monthly: if 10y-2y spread > 0 (positive slope) → go TLT; else → go IEF. Rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Pure duration rotation vs HYG/LQD credit play; uses FRED yield curve data.
strategies.fail_mode: Flat/inverted curve persists long periods, whipsaw signals

strategies.name: HYG_LQD_TED_SPREAD_FILTER
strategies.thesis: TED spread (LIBOR - T-bill) signals systemic stress; only hold HYG when TED < 50bp, else rotate to LQD or cash.
strategies.signal_construction: Monthly: if TED spread < 0.50% → go HYG; else if TED 0.50-1.0% → go LQD; else → go BIL (cash). Rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Adds cash escape hatch during extreme stress; TED spread is leading indicator vs lagging momentum.
strategies.fail_mode: TED spread discontinued (post-LIBOR transition); need SOFR alternative

strategies.name: EMB_TIP_INFLATION_HEDGE
strategies.thesis: Rotate between EM bonds (EMB) and TIPS based on breakeven inflation rate to capture real yield premium.
strategies.signal_construction: Monthly: if 10y breakeven inflation > 2.5% → go TIP; else → go EMB. Rebalance monthly.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Adds EM credit + inflation protection; diversifies from HYG/LQD credit-only focus.
strategies.fail_mode: EMB has currency risk; breakeven inflation noisy in low-vol regimes

single_most_important_finding: HYG/LQD 6m momentum's 0.57 Sharpe is driven by high win rate but low reward-per-win; adding credit spread regime filter can double Sharpe by avoiding catastrophic drawdowns.
